name: dev host memory — available RAM below 25.5% of total (24 GiB on vmi3006760), per host
description: Fires per host.name when a dev host's MIN(system.linux.memory.available / system.memory.limit) over 10 min is below 0.255: the load guard's 24 GiB floor on vmi3006760 (94 GiB), about 32 GiB on hetzner-xubuntu (125 GiB). Early warning; the 8 GiB critical floor is host-memory-available-critical-floor. Hosts are selected by the resource attribute livespec.host.role = dev-host, which the dev-host collector shape stamps, so a dev host joins by running that shape (thewoolleyman/otel-collector config.yaml and its livespec-only variant), never by a copy of this trigger. Cause on 2026-11-13: RAM-backed /tmp at 35-38G, Dolt OOM-killed 15:32:41Z. Runbook: /var/tmp/vps-load-guard.sh; free -g; df -h /tmp /dev/shm; sudo du -xd1 /tmp | sort -h | tail; ps aux --sort=-rss | head. Owner: legacy-coordinator-agent routing, kubernetes-observability seat.
